title: Go bindless with Metal 3
description: Learn how you can unleash powerful rendering techniques like ray tracing when you go bindless with Metal 3. We'll show you how to make your app’s bindless journey a joy by simplifying argument buffers, allocating acceleration structures from heaps, and benefitting from the improvements to the Metal’s validation layer and Debugger Tools. We'll also explore how you can command more CPU and GPU performance with long-term resource structures.
